tracing::Span::current()\n152\t                        .record(\"otel.status_description\", format!(\"verify failed: {e}\"));\n153\t                    return Ok(ClaimOutcome::StoreError(e));\n154\t                }\n155\t            };\n156\t\n157\t            if current.status != BeadStatus::Open || current.assignee.is_some() {\n158\t                drop(lock_file);\n159\t                //       Ok(ClaimOutcome::AllRaceLost)\n237\t    }\n238\t\n239\t    /// Convenience: claim a single bead by ID (fetches the bead, then delegates\n240\t    /// to `claim_next` with a single-element All workers\n343\t/// compute the same hash for the same workspace.\n344\tfn workspace_lock_path(lock_dir: &Path, workspace: &Path) -> PathBuf {\n345\t    let mut hasher = std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher::new();\n346\t    workspace.hash(&mut hasher);\n347\t    let hash = hasher.finish();\n348\t    lock_dir.join(format!(\"needle-claim-{:016x}.lock\", hash))\n349\t}\n350\t\n351\t/// Acquire an exclusive flock with a 10-second timeout.\n352\t///\n353\t/// Returns the locked file on success. The lock is released when the\n354\t/// file is dropped (flock auto-releases on close).\n355\tpub async fn acquire_flock(lock_path: &Path) -> Result<std::fs::File> {\n356\t    if let Some(parent) = lock_path.parent() {\n357\t        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n358\t    }\n359\t\n360\t    let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n361\t        .create(true)\n362\t        .truncate(false)\n363\t        .write(true)\n364\t        .open(lock_path)?;\n365\t\n366\t    let deadline = Instant::now() + FLOCK_TIMEOUT;\n367\t    loop {\n368\t        match file.try_lock_exclusive() {\n369\t            Ok(()) => return Ok(file),\n370\t            Err(ref e) if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {\n371\t                if Instant::now() >= deadline {\n372\t                    return Err(anyhow!(\n373\t                        \"flock timeout after {}s on {}\",\n374\t                        FLOCK_TIMEOUT.as_secs(),\n375\t                        lock_path.display()\n376\t                    ));\n377\t                }\n378\t                tokio::time::sleep(FLOCK_POLL_INTERVAL).await;\n379\t            }\n380\t            Err(e) => return Err(e.into()),\n381\t        }\n382\t    }\n383\t}\n384\t\n385\t// ─── Unit tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n386\t\n387\t#[cfg(test)]\n388\tmod tests {\n389\t tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.claim.result\", \"max_retries_exceeded\");\n                // Set Error status on the bead.claim span\n                tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_code\", 2u64);\n                tracing::Span::current().record(\"otel.status_description\", \"max_retries_exceeded\");\n                return Ok(ClaimOutcome::AllRaceLost);\n            }\n\n            attempts += 1;\n            let bead_id = &candidate.id;\n\n            // Set bead_id and retry_number as span attributes.\n            tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.bead.id\", bead_id.as_ref());\n            tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.claim.retry_number\", attempts);\n\n completion.sample,\n                    detected_at,\n                },\n            }));\n        }\n\n        Ok(None)\n    }\n\n    /// Detect claim churn: repeated race_lost events for the same bead.\n    fn detect_claim_churn(&self, events: &[TelemetryEventLike]) -> Option<ClaimChurnInfo> {\n        let mut race_lost_counts: HashMap<String, u32> = HashMap::new();\n        let mut sample: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n\n        for ev in events.iter().rev() {\n            if ev.event_type == \"bead.claim.race_lost\" {\n                if let Some(bead_id) = &ev.bead_id {\n                    *race_lost_counts.entry(bead_id.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;\n                    if sample.len() < 10 {\n                        sample.push(format!(\"{} race_lost {}\", ev.timestamp, bead_id));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        for (bead_id, count) in &race_lost_counts {\n            if *count >= self.config.claim_churn_threshold {\n                return Some(ClaimChurnInfo {\n                    bead_id: bead_id.clone(),\n                    count: *count,\n                    sample,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        None\n    }\n\n    /// Detect state ping-pong: short state cycles without forward progress.\n    fn detect_state_ping_pong(&self, events: &[TelemetryEventLike]) -> Option<StatePingPongInfo> {\n        // Look for state_transition events and extract state sequences.\n        let mut state_transitions: Vec<(DateTime<Utc>, String, String)> = Vec::new();\n\n        for ev in events.iter().rev() {\n            if ev.event_type == \"worker.state_transition\" {\n                if let (Some(from), Some(to)) = (&ev.data.get(\"from\"), &ev.data.get(\"to\")) {\n                    if let (Some(from_str), Some(to_str)) = (from.as_str(), to.as_str()) {\n                        state_transitions.push((\n                            ev.timestamp,\n                            from_str.to_string(),\n                            to_str.to_string(),\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if state_transitions.len() < 8 {\n            return None; // Not enough transitions to detect a cycle.\n        }\n\n        // Check for cycles of length <= 4 states.\n        let window_size = 8.min(state_transitions.len());\n        let window: Vec<_> = state_transitions\n            .iter()\n            .take(window_size)\n            .map(|(_, _, to)| to.clone())\n            .collect();\n\n        // Count unique states in the window.\n        let unique_states: HashSet<_> = window.iter().collect();\n\n        if unique_states.len() <= 4 && window.len() >= 6 {\n            // Check if we're cycling without forward-progress events.\n            let has_forward_progress = events\n                .iter()\n                .any(|ev| matches!(ev.event_type.as_str(), \"agent.completed\" | \"bead.completed\"));\n\n            if !has_forward_progress {\n                let sample = state_transitions\n                    .iter()\n                    .take(10)\n                    .map(|(ts, from, to)| format!(\"{} {} -> {}\", ts.format(\"%H:%M:%S\"), from, to))\n                    .collect();\n\n                return Some(StatePingPongInfo {\n                    states: unique_states.iter().map(|s| (*s).clone()).collect(),\n                    cycle_count: (window.len() / unique_states.len()) as u32,\n                    sample,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        None\n    }\n\n    /// Detect log runaway: excessive file growth without completion events.\n    fn detect_log_runaway(\n        &self,\n        _record: &HeartbeatRecord,\n        log_path: &Path,\n        events: &[TelemetryEventLike],\n    ) -> Result<Option<LogRunawayInfo>> {\n        let metadata = std::fs::metadata(log_path)?;\n        let file_size = metadata.len();\n\n        // Check for agent.completed events in the scanned window.\n        let has_completed = events\n            .iter()\n            .any(|ev| ev.event_type == \"agent.completed\" || ev.event_type == \"bead.completed\");\n\n        if !has_completed && file_size > self.config.log_runaway_bytes {\n            // Calculate time window from oldest to newest event.\n            if let (Some(oldest), Some(newest)) = (events.first(), events.last()) {\n                let window_secs = (newest.timestamp - oldest.timestamp).num_seconds().max(1) as u64;\n\n                if window_secs <= self.config.live_loop_window_secs {\n                    let sample = events\n                        .iter()\n                        .rev()\n                        .take(10)\n                        .map(|ev| format!(\"{} {}\", ev.timestamp, ev.event_type))\n                        .collect();\n\n                    return Ok(Some(LogRunawayInfo {\n                        bytes_growth: file_size,\n                        window_secs,\n                        sample,\n                    }));\n                }\n            }\n\n            // If we can't calculate window but file is huge and no completion, still flag.\n            if file_size > self.config.log_runaway_bytes * 2 {\n                let sample = events\n                    .iter()\n                    .rev()\n                    .take(10)\n                    .map(|ev| format!(\"{} {}\", ev.timestamp, ev.event_type))\n                    .collect();\n\n                return Ok(Some(LogRunawayInfo {\n                    bytes_growth: file_size,\n                    window_secs: self.config.live_loop_window_secs,\n                    sample,\n                }));\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(None)\n    }\n\n    /// Detect completion without resolution: many agent.completed events but bead never closes.\n    ///\n    /// This detects the pattern where a bead is claimed, the agent completes successfully,\n    /// but the bead is orphaned (not closed) and then reclaimed—repeating indefinitely.\n    /// The key signal is N agent.completed events for the same bead with 0 bead.completed events.\n    fn detect_completion_without_resolution(\n        &self,\n        events: &[TelemetryEventLike],\n    ) -> Option<CompletionWithoutResolutionInfo> {\n        // Track event counts per bead_id\n        let mut claim_succeeded_counts: HashMap<String, u32> = HashMap::new();\n        let mut orphaned_counts: HashMap<String, u32> = HashMap::new();\n        let mut agent_completed_counts: HashMap<String, u32> = HashMap::new();\n        let mut bead_completed_seen: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();\n        let mut sample: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n\n        for ev in events.iter().rev() {\n            let bead_id = match &ev.bead_id {\n                Some(id) => id.clone(),\n                None => continue,\n            };\n\n            // Track relevant events\n            match ev.event_type.as_str() {\n                \"bead.claim.succeeded\" => {\n                    *claim_succeeded_counts.entry(bead_id.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;\n                    if sample.len() < 10 {\n                        sample.push(format!(\"{} claim.succeeded {}\", ev.timestamp, bead_id));\n                    }\n                }\n                \"bead.orphaned\" => {\n                    *orphaned_counts.entry(bead_id.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;\n                    if sample.len() < 10 {\n                        sample.push(format!(\"{} orphaned {}\", ev.timestamp, bead_id));\n                    }\n                }\n                \"agent.completed\" => {\n                    *agent_completed_counts.entry(bead_id.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;\n                    if sample.len() < 10 {\n                        sample.push(format!(\"{} agent.completed {}\", ev.timestamp, bead_id));\n                    }\n                }\n                \"bead.completed\" => {\n                    bead_completed_seen.insert(bead_id);\n                }\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check for beads with the problematic pattern:\n        // - High claim_succeeded count (indicating repeated claims)\n        // - High orphaned count (indicating the bead is being released without closure)\n        // - High agent_completed count (agents are succeeding)\n        // - NO bead.completed event (the bead never actually closes)\n        //\n        // The bf-34xw9 incident showed: 41 claim.succeeded, 25 orphaned, 42 agent.completed, 1 bead.completed\n        // We need thresholds that catch this pattern. Using claim_churn_threshold (20) as baseline.\n\n        for (bead_id, &agent_completed_count) in &agent_completed_counts {\n            // Skip if bead was completed (not stuck)\n            if bead_completed_seen.contains(bead_id) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            let claim_succeeded_count = claim_succeeded_counts.get(bead_id).copied().unwrap_or(0);\n            let orphaned_count = orphaned_counts.get(bead_id).copied().unwrap_or(0);\n\n            // Detect the pattern: high activity but no resolution\n            // Threshold: at least claim_churn_threshold agent.completed events\n            // AND significant claim/orphan activity (at least 5 each to avoid noise)\n            if agent_completed_count >= self.config.claim_churn_threshold\n                && claim_succeeded_count >= 5\n                && orphaned_count >= 5\n            {\n                return Some(CompletionWithoutResolutionInfo {\n                    bead_id: bead_id.clone(),\n                    claim_succeeded_count,\n                    orphaned_count,\n                    agent_completed_count,\n                    sample,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        None\n    }\n\n    /// Scan for failed workers (stale heartbeat + dead tmux session).\n    ///\n    /// Returns a list of heartbeat records for workers that are considered dead.\n    fn scan_failed_workers(&self) -> Result<Vec<HeartbeatRecord>> {\n        let mut failed = Vec::new();\n\n        // Read all *.json files from heartbeat directory.\n        let entries = match std::fs::read_dir(&self.heartbeat_dir) {\n            Ok(e) => e,\n            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {\n                tracing::debug!(\"splice: heartbeat directory does not exist\");\n                return Ok(Vec::new());\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                return Err(e).context(\"failed to read heartbeat directory\");\n            }\n        };\n\n        for entry in entries {\n            let entry = match entry {\n                Ok(e) => e,\n                Err(_) => continue,\n            };\n\n            let path = entry.path();\n            if path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) != Some(\"json\") {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Parse the heartbeat file.\n            let content = match std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {\n                Ok(c) => c,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        path = %path.display(),\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"splice: failed to read heartbeat file\"\n                    );\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            let record: HeartbeatRecord = match serde_json::from_str(&content) {\n                Ok(r) => r,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        path = %path.display(),\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"splice: failed to parse heartbeat file\"\n                    );\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            // Check if heartbeat is stale.\n            let elapsed = Utc::now() - record.last_heartbeat;\n            let stale_threshold_secs = self.config.stale_threshold_secs as i64;\n            if elapsed.num_seconds() < stale_threshold_secs {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Check if tmux session is still alive.\n            let alive = std::process::Command::new(\"tmux\")\n                .args([\"has-session\", \"-t\", &record.session])\n                .status()\n                .map(|s| s.success())\n                .unwrap_or(false);\n\n            if !alive {\n                // Session is dead — this is a failed worker.\n                failed.push(record);\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(failed)\n    }\n\n    /// Document a worker failure by creating a bead in the report workspace.\n    ///\n    /// If `report_workspace` is None or the workspace is invalid, returns Ok(())\n    /// without creating a bead.\n    async fn document_failure(&self, record: &HeartbeatRecord) -> Result<()> {\n        let report_workspace = match &self.config.report_workspace {\n            Some(ws) => ws,\n            None => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    worker_id = %record.worker_id,\n                    session = %record.session,\n                    \"splice: no report workspace configured, skipping bead creation\"\n                );\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Verify the workspace exists and has a .beads/ subdirectory.\n        let beads_dir = report_workspace.join(\".beads\");\n        if !report_workspace.exists() || !beads_dir.exists() {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                workspace = %report_workspace.display(),\n                worker_id = %record.worker_id,\n                \"splice: report workspace does not exist or has no .beads/ directory\"\n            );\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        // Instantiate bead store for the report workspace.\n        let store = BrCliBeadStore::discover(report_workspace.clone())\n            .context(\"failed to instantiate bead store for report workspace\")?;\n\n        // Build bead title.\n        let title = format!(\"Worker failure: {} ({})\", record.worker_id, record.session);\n\n        // Calculate elapsed time since last heartbeat.\n        let elapsed = Utc::now() - record.last_heartbeat;\n        let elapsed_secs = elapsed.num_seconds();\n        let elapsed_mins = elapsed_secs / 60;\n        let elapsed_hours = elapsed_mins / 60;\n        let elapsed_str = if elapsed_hours > 0 {\n            format!(\"{}h {}m\", elapsed_hours, elapsed_mins % 60)\n        } else if elapsed_mins > 0 {\n            format!(\"{}m\", elapsed_mins)\n        } else {\n            format!(\"{}s\", elapsed_secs)\n        };\n\n        // Build bead body.\n        let current_bead_str = record.current_bead.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"(none)\");\n        let body = format!(\n            \"## Worker Failure\\n\\n\\\n             **Worker:** {}\\n\\\n             **Session:** {}\\n\\\n             **Workspace:** {}\\n\\\n             **Last heartbeat:** {} ({} ago)\\n\\\n             **State at failure:** {}\\n\\\n             **Beads processed:** {}\\n\\\n             **Current bead:** {}\\n\\\n             **PID:** {}\\n\",\n            record.worker_id,\n            record.session,\n            record.workspace,\n            record.last_heartbeat.format(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC\"),\n            elapsed_str,\n            record.state,\n            record.beads_processed,\n            current_bead_str,\n            record.pid\n        );\n\n        // Create the bead.\n        let bead_id = store\n            .create_bead(&title, &body, &[\"worker-failure\", \"human\"])\n            .await\n            .context(\"failed to create worker failure bead\")?;\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            worker_id = %record.worker_id,\n            session = %record.session,\n            bead_id = %bead_id,\n            \"splice: documented worker failure\"\n        );\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Document a live-loop worker by creating a bead in the report workspace.\n    ///\n    /// If `report_workspace` is None or the workspace is invalid, returns Ok(())\n    /// without creating a bead.\n    async fn document_live_loop(&self, worker: &LiveLoopWorker) -> Result<()> {\n        let report_workspace = match &self.config.report_workspace {\n            Some(ws) => ws,\n            None => {\n                tracing::debug!(\n                    worker_id = %worker.heartbeat.worker_id,\n                    session = %worker.heartbeat.session,\n                    \"splice: no report workspace configured, skipping loop bead creation\"\n                );\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Verify the workspace exists and has a .beads/ subdirectory.\n        let beads_dir = report_workspace.join(\".beads\");\n        if !report_workspace.exists() || !beads_dir.exists() {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                workspace = %report_workspace.display(),\n                worker_id = %worker.heartbeat.worker_id,\n                \"splice: report workspace does not exist or has no .beads/ directory\"\n            );\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n\n        // Instantiate bead store for the report workspace.\n        let store = BrCliBeadStore::discover(report_workspace.clone())\n            .context(\"failed to instantiate bead store for report workspace\")?;\n\n        // Build bead title and body based on loop type, and extract the stuck bead_id.\n        let (title, pattern_name, details, stuck_bead_id) = match &worker.loop_type {\n            LoopType::ClaimChurn { bead_id, count } => {\n                let title = format!(\n                    \"Live loop: {} claim churn on bead {}\",\n                    worker.heartbeat.worker_id, bead_id\n                );\n                let details = format!(\n                    \"**Pattern:** Claim churn\\n\\\n                     **Bead ID:** {}\\n\\\n                     **Race-lost events (in last {}):** {}\\n\",\n                    bead_id, worker.evidence.events_scanned, count\n                );\n                (title, \"claim_churn\".to_string(), details, Some(bead_id.clone()))\n            }\n            LoopType::StatePingPong {\n                states,\n                cycle_count,\n            } => {\n                let title = format!(\"Live loop: {} state ping-pong\", worker.heartbeat.worker_id);\n                let state_list = states.join(\" → \");\n                let details = format!(\n                    \"**Pattern:** State ping-pong\\n\\\n                     **States:** {}\\n\\\n                     **Cycles detected:** {}\\n\",\n                    state_list, cycle_count\n                );\n                (title, \"state_ping_pong\".to_string(), details, None)\n            }\n            LoopType::LogRunaway {\n                bytes_growth,\n                window_secs,\n            } => {\n                let title = format!(\n                    \"Live loop: {} log runaway ({} MB)\",\n                    worker.heartbeat.worker_id,\n                    bytes_growth / 1024 / 1024\n                );\n                let details = format!(\n                    \"**Pattern:** Log runaway\\n\\\n                     **JSONL growth:** {} MB\\n\\\n                     **Time window:** {}s\\n\\\n                     **No completion events detected**\\n\",\n                    bytes_growth / 1024 / 1024,\n                    window_secs\n                );\n                (title, \"log_runaway\".to_string(), details, None)\n            }\n            LoopType::CompletionWithoutResolution {\n                bead_id,\n                claim_succeeded_count,\n                orphaned_count,\n                agent_completed_count,\n            } => {\n                let title = format!(\n                    \"Live loop: {} completion without resolution on bead {}\",\n                    worker.heartbeat.worker_id, bead_id\n                );\n                let details = format!(\n                    \"**Pattern:** Completion without resolution\\n\\\n                     **Bead ID:** {}\\n\\\n                     **Claim succeeded events:** {}\\n\\\n                     **Orphaned events:** {}\\n\\\n                     **Agent completed events:** {}\\n\\\n \"completion_without_resolution\".to_string(), details, Some(bead_id.clone()))\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Build sample events section.\n        let sample_section = if worker.evidence.sample_events.is_empty() {\n            String::new()\n        } else {\n            let samples: String = worker\n                .evidence\n                .sample_events\n                .iter()\n                .take(20)\n                .map(|s| format!(\"  - {}\\n\", s))\n                .collect();\n            format!(\n                \"\\n## Sample Events (last {} scanned)\\n\\n```\\n{}\\n```\\n\",\n                worker.evidence.events_scanned, samples\n            )\n        };\n\n        let body = format!(\n            \"## Live Worker Loop Detected\\n\\n\\\n             **Worker:** {}\\n\\\n             **Session:** {}\\n\\\n             **Workspace:** {}\\n\\\n             **Last heartbeat:** {}\\n\\\n             **State:** {}\\n\\\n             **Beads processed:** {}\\n\\\n             **Detected at:** {}\\n\\n\\\n             ## Pattern Details\\n\\n\\\n             {}{}\\n\\\n             ## Context\\n\\n\\\n             Worker is alive (fresh heartbeat) but making no forward progress.\\n\\\n             Consider investigating the selector or agent dispatch logic.\",\n            worker.heartbeat.worker_id,\n            worker.heartbeat.session,\n            worker.heartbeat.workspace,\n            worker\n                .heartbeat\n                .last_heartbeat\n                .format(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC\"),\n            worker.heartbeat.state,\n            worker.heartbeat.beads_processed,\n            worker.evidence.detected_at.format(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC\"),\n            details,\n            sample_section\n        );\n\n        // Create the bead.\n        let bead_id = store\n            .create_bead(&title, &body, &[\"worker-loop\", \"human\"])\n            .await\n            .context(\"failed to create worker loop bead\")?;\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            worker_id = %worker.heartbeat.worker_id,\n            session = %worker.heartbeat.session,\n \"human\"\n        // in its original workspace so Pluck stops redispatching it and Unravel can pick it up.\n        // This is the circuit breaker that prevents the retry storm.\n        if let Some(stuck_bead_id) = stuck_bead_id {\n            // Get the original workspace from the worker's heartbeat\n            let original_workspace = &worker.heartbeat.workspace;\n            let workspace_path = PathBuf::from(original_workspace);\n\n            // Verify the workspace exists and has a .beads/ subdirectory\n            let beads_dir = workspace_path.join(\".beads\");\n            if workspace_path.exists() && beads_dir.exists() {\n                // Instantiate bead store for the original workspace\n                if let Ok(original_store) = BrCliBeadStore::discover(workspace_path.clone()) {\n                    // Label the stuck bead as \"human\" to stop Pluck from redispatching it\n                    if let Ok(_) = original_store.add_label(&stuck_bead_id, \"human\").await {\n                        tracing::info!(\n                            stuck_bead_id = %stuck_bead_id,\n                            workspace = %original_workspace,\n                            \"splice: labeled stuck bead as human to stop redispatch\"\n                        );\n                    } else {\n                        tracing::warn!(\n                            stuck_bead_id = %stuck_bead_id,\n                            workspace = %original_workspace,\n                            \"splice: failed to label stuck bead as human\"\n                        );\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        stuck_bead_id = %stuck_bead_id,\n                        workspace = %original_workspace,\n                        \"splice: failed to instantiate bead store for original workspace\"\n                    );\n                }\n            } else {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    stuck_bead_id = %stuck_bead_id,\n                    workspace = %original_workspace,\n                    \"splice: original workspace does not exist or has no .beads/ directory\"\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n#[async_trait::async_trait]\nimpl super::Strand for SpliceStrand {\n    fn name(&self) -> &str {\n        \"splice\"\n    }\n\n    async fn evaluate(&self, _store: &dyn BeadStore) -> StrandResult {\n        if !self.config.enabled {\n            return StrandResult::NoWork;\n        }\n\n        let mut state = SpliceState::load(&self.state_dir)\n            .ok()\n            .flatten()\n            .unwrap_or_default();\n        let mut documented = 0usize;\n\n        // Scan for failed workers (stale heartbeat + dead tmux session).\n        let failed = match self.scan_failed_workers() {\n            Ok(f) => f,\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"splice: failed to scan heartbeats\");\n                return StrandResult::NoWork;\n            }\n        };\n\n        for record in &failed {\n            if state.documented_sessions.contains(&record.session) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            match self.document_failure(record).await {\n                Ok(()) => {\n                    state.documented_sessions.insert(record.session.clone());\n                    documented += 1;\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        worker_id = %record.worker_id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"splice: failed to document worker failure\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Scan for live-but-looping workers.\n        let looping = match self.scan_live_loops() {\n            Ok(l) => l,\n            Err(e) => {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %e, \"splice: failed to scan for live loops\");\n                Vec::new()\n            }\n        };\n\n        for worker in &looping {\n            // Build de-duplication key: (worker_id, session_id, pattern_name)\n            let pattern_name = match &worker.loop_type {\n                LoopType::ClaimChurn { .. } => \"claim_churn\",\n                LoopType::StatePingPong { .. } => \"state_ping_pong\",\n                LoopType::LogRunaway { .. } => \"log_runaway\",\n            };\n            let key = format!(\n                \"{}-{}-{}\",\n                worker.heartbeat.worker_id, worker.heartbeat.session, pattern_name\n            );\n\n            if state.documented_loops.contains(&key) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            match self.document_live_loop(worker).await {\n                Ok(()) => {\n                    state.documented_loops.insert(key);\n                    documented += 1;\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    tracing::warn!(\n                        worker_id = %worker.heartbeat.worker_id,\n                        error = %e,\n                        \"splice: failed to document live loop\"\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if documented > 0 {\n            let _ = state.save(&self.state_dir);\n            tracing::info!(documented, \"splice: documented worker failures and loops\");\n            StrandResult::WorkCreated\n        } else {\n            StrandResult::NoWork\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Bead-Id commit trailer injection.\n//!\n//! When a bead closes with a commit artifact (i.e. the agent made commits),\n//! NEEDLE amends the latest commit to include a `Bead-Id: <id>` trailer.\n//! HOOP's bead_commit_index then picks this up via `git log`.\n\nuse std::io;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::time::{Duration, Instant};\n\nuse anyhow::{anyhow, Result};\nuse fs2::FileExt;\nuse tokio::process::Command;\n\nuse crate::types::BeadId;\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Public entry point\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Inject a `Bead-Id: <id>` trailer into the latest commit in `workspace`.\n///\n/// Only acts when HEAD moved since `pre_dispatch_head` (i.e. the agent made\n/// at least one commit). Returns `Ok(())` in all no-op cases (not a git repo,\n/// no new commits, trailer already present). Errors are logged by callers as\n/// non-fatal warnings.\n///\n/// This function uses a per-workspace advisory lock (flock) to serialize\n/// the read-HEAD → verify → amend sequence. Inside the lock, it verifies that\n/// the commit at HEAD actually corresponds to this bead by checking the commit\n/// subject contains the bead ID (per the NEEDLE commit convention:\n/// `fix(needle-XYZ): ...`). This prevents cross-tagging commits when multiple\n/// workers dispatch concurrently in the same workspace.\npub async fn inject_bead_id_trailer(\n    workspace: &Path,\n    bead_id: &BeadId,\n    pre_dispatch_head: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let ws = workspace.to_str().unwrap_or(\".\").to_string();\n\n    // Get current HEAD — if it fails, workspace is not a git repo.\n    let current_head = match git_head(&ws).await {\n        Ok(h) => h,\n        Err(_) => return Ok(()),\n    };\n\n    // No new commits → nothing to tag.\n    if current_head == pre_dispatch_head {\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Check if the trailer is already present (idempotent).\n    if already_has_trailer(&ws, bead_id).await? {\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Acquire workspace flock to serialize the verify → amend sequence.\n    // The lock path is deterministic for the workspace: <workspace>/.git/needle-trailer.lock\n    let lock_path = trailer_lock_path(workspace);\n    let _lock = match acquire_flock(&lock_path).await {\n        Ok(f) => f,\n        Err(e) => {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                bead_id = %bead_id,\n                workspace = %ws,\n                error = %e,\n                \"failed to acquire trailer flock, skipping injection\"\n            );\n            // Return Ok instead of Err — this is a non-fatal step\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Re-read HEAD inside the lock — it may have changed while we waited.\n    let current_head = match git_head(&ws).await {\n        Ok(h) => h,\n        Err(_) => return Ok(()),\n    };\n\n    // No new commits → nothing to tag (re-check after acquiring lock).\n    if current_head == pre_dispatch_head {\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Verify that the commit at HEAD actually belongs to this bead.\n    // The NEEDLE commit convention puts the bead ID in the subject line:\n    // \"feat(needle-XYZ): ...\" or \"fix(needle-XYZ): ...\"\n    let head_subject = git_head_subject(&ws).await?;\n    let bead_id_str = bead_id.as_ref();\n    if !head_subject.contains(bead_id_str) {\n        tracing::warn!(\n            bead_id = %bead_id,\n            workspace = %ws,\n            head_subject = %head_subject,\n            current_head = %current_head,\n            \"HEAD commit does not match this bead, skipping trailer injection to avoid mislabeling\"\n        );\n        // Skip injection rather than mislabel another bead's commit.\n        // The lock ensures we don't race with another worker injecting its own trailer.\n        return Ok(());\n    }\n\n    // Amend the latest commit to add the Bead-Id trailer.\n    // Wrapped in a 30-second timeout to prevent indefinite hangs if git\n    // subprocess hangs (e.g., due to filesystem issues or network mounts).\n    let trailer_arg = format!(\"Bead-Id: {}\", bead_id);\n    let out = tokio::time::timeout(\n        std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n        Command::new(\"git\")\n            .args([\n                \"-C\",\n                &ws,\n                \"commit\",\n                \"--amend\",\n                \"--no-edit\",\n                \"--trailer\",\n                &trailer_arg,\n            ])\n            .output(),\n    )\n    .await\n    .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!(\"git commit --amend timed out after 30s in {}\", ws))??;\n\n    if !out.status.success() {\n        let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr);\n        anyhow::bail!(\"git commit --amend failed: {}\", stderr.trim());\n    }\n\n    tracing::info!(\n        bead_id = %bead_id,\n        workspace = %ws,\n        \"injected Bead-Id trailer into latest commit\"\n    );\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Return the current HEAD SHA for `workspace`.\n///\n/// Wrapped in a 10-second timeout to prevent indefinite hangs if git\n/// subprocess hangs (e.g., due to filesystem issues or network mounts).\npub(crate) async fn git_head(workspace: &str) -> Result<String> {\n    let out = tokio::time::timeout(\n        std::time::Duration::from_secs(10),\n        Command::new(\"git\")\n            .args([\"-C\", workspace, \"rev-parse\", \"HEAD\"])\n            .output(),\n    )\n    .await\n    .map_err(|_| .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!(\"git log timed out after 10s in {}\", workspace))??;\n\n    if !out.status.success() {\n        anyhow::bail!(\"git log failed in {}\", workspace);\n    }\n    Ok(String::from_utf8(out.stdout)?.trim().to_string())\n}\n\n/// Compute the trailer lock file path for a workspace.\n///\n/// Uses `.git/needle-trailer.lock` within the workspace directory.\n/// All The lock is released when the\n/// file is dropped (flock auto-releases on close).\nasync fn acquire_flock(lock_path: &Path) -> Result<std::fs::File> {\n    if let Some(parent) = lock_path.parent() {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;\n    }\n\n    let file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n        .create(true)\n        .truncate(false)\n        .write(true)\n        .open(lock_path)?;\n\n None\n    }\n\n    /// Detect state ping-pong: short state cycles without forward progress.\n    fn detect_state_ping_pong(&self, events: &[TelemetryEventLike]) -> Option<StatePingPongInfo> {\n                    to_str.to_string(),\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if state_transitions.len() < 8 {\n            return }\n\n    /// Detect log runaway: excessive file growth without completion events.\n    fn detect_log_runaway(\n        &self,\n        _record: &HeartbeatRecord,\n        log_path: &Path,\n        events: &[TelemetryEventLike],\n    ) -> Result<Option<LogRunawayInfo>> {\n        let metadata = std::fs::metadata(log_path)?;\n        let file_size = metadata.len();\n\n        // Check for \"bead.completed\");\n\n        if !has_completed && file_size > self.config.log_runaway_bytes {\n            // Calculate time window from oldest to newest event.\n            if let (Some(oldest), self.config.live_loop_window_secs {\n                    let sample = events\n                        .iter()\n                        .rev()\n                        .take(10)\n huge and no completion, still flag.\n            if file_size > self.config.log_runaway_bytes * 2 {\n                let sample = events\n                    .iter()\n                    .rev()\n                    .take(10)\n                    .map(|ev| format!(\"{} {}\", ev.timestamp, ev.event_type))\n                    .collect();\n\n                return Ok(Some(LogRunawayInfo {\n      if sample.len() < 10 {\n                        sample.push(format!(\"{} claim.succeeded {}\", ev.timestamp, bead_id));\n                    }\n                }\n                \"bead.orphaned\" => {\n                    *orphaned_counts.entry(bead_id.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;\n                    if sample.len() < 10 {\n                        sample.push(format!(\"{}                 claim_succeeded_count,\n                    orphaned_count,\n                    agent_completed_count,\n                    sample,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        None\n    }\n\n    /// Scan for failed workers (stale heartbeat + dead tmux session).\n    ///\n    /// Returns a list of heartbeat records for workers that are considered dead.\n    fn
